theorem DAllSourceKernel.both_tests_original_kernel_connection.{u_1} : ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K]
  [inst_1 : NumberField K] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
  [inst_3 : MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] [inst_4 : MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  (addHaar : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)) (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K))
  [inst_5 : mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] [inst_6 : SFinite mu] [inst_7 : IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu] (a l r s : ℝ)
  (hlr : l ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (phi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous phi)
  (hc : HasCompactSupport phi) (q : Fin 2) (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
  have tests := ⋯;
  have b := fun x => PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x);
  have A := PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q) ⋯ ⋯;
  let E :=
    DSourceKernel.sourceSpan mu 0 0 (OAllCharacterClosure.fullSourceMap K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s);
  have S := (JThetaAttachment.fullThetaClosure K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s).starProjection;
  (∀ (T : Finset ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
      (fun x => ↑↑((E T).starProjection (A F)) x) =ᶠ[ae mu] fun x =>
        ↑(b x) *
          ∫ (y : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b (E T) A x y * (↑↑F y / ↑(b y)) ∂mu) ∧
    (∀ (T : Finset ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
        Integrable (fun x => DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b (E T) A x x) mu ∧
          ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b (E T) A x x ∂mu =
            Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((E T).starProjection.comp A)) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun T => A F - (E T).starProjection (A F)) Filter.atTop (nhds (A F - S (A F))) :=

theorem DAllSourceKernel.original_residual_diagonal.{u_1} : ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [inst_3 : MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  [inst_4 : MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] (addHaar : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K))
  (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [inst_5 : mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] [inst_6 : SFinite mu]
  [inst_7 : IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu] (a l r s : ℝ) (hlr : l ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
  (phi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous phi) (hc : HasCompactSupport phi),
  (∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x = 0 → phi x = 0) →
    ∀ (q : Fin 2),
      let h := LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q;
      have tests := ⋯;
      have A := PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs h ⋯ ⋯;
      have b := fun x => PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x);
      let E :=
        DSourceKernel.sourceSpan mu 0 0
          (OAllCharacterClosure.fullSourceMap K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s);
      have k := fun T => DSourceKernel.residualKernel mu b (E T) A fun x y => h (x * y⁻¹);
      ∀ (T : Finset ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
        (∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), k T x x = -DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b (E T) A x x) ∧
          Integrable (fun x => k T x x) mu ∧
            ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), k T x x ∂mu =
                -Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((E T).starProjection.comp A) ∧
              Filter.Tendsto
                (fun n =>
                  ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), (DReview.physicalBand K n).indicator (fun x => k T x x) x ∂mu)
                Filter.atTop (nhds (-Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((E T).starProjection.comp A))) :=
⋯
